scope: Proposition 5.2 (Known probability from deferred filters) of the manuscript “Exact quantum factoring over a fixed finite gate set” (preprints/Exact-quantum-factoring-over-a-fixed-finite-gate-set-September-25-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 279 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 35e89279253b6c8a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The implemented preparation just described has success probability exactly p∗ = (1 − 2−n )n10 . (27) Every successful branch outputs the correct prime factorization of N. The preparation has polyno- mial worst-case time and workspace, and p∗ > 1/2 is an initially known dyadic with polynomial bit length.
